description: The round-1 fix added a non-string element guard to Email/set and EmailSubmission/set destroy arrays (RFC 8620 §3.6.2). Neither handler has a test exercising this guard. Add tests: (1) Email/set with destroy: [123] returns invalidArguments; (2) EmailSubmission/set with destroy: [true] returns invalidArguments.
title: No test: destroy array non-string returns invalidArguments
